postal_system.assignment_rule: A current Poste San Marino assignment release or separately permitted operator evidence establishes a five-digit 4789x CAP assignment. A postal-office address proves only that office address and does not establish a complete national assignment denominator, delivery coverage, or area boundary.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: No nationwide official CAP polygon source is assumed. Castello or sobborgo administration, cadastral/cartographic objects, office locations, embedded map points, settlements, streets, addresses, buildings, parcels, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, or synthetic fixtures never become CAP perimeters. Dogana 47891 and Serravalle 47899 require a source-defined split rather than an inferred partition of Serravalle.
postal_system.address_rule: Postal assignment, address identity, Castello/sobborgo administration, cadastral/cartographic geometry, office service state, and building relationships remain separate assertions.
postal_system.building_rule: Building output requires a separately sourced explicit distributable address-building relationship or common authoritative identifier; postcode, administration, proximity, containment, office, parcel, and point evidence are insufficient.
postal_system.administrative_rule: The nine Castelli and their sobborgo subdivisions are administrative context, not postal authority. The official CASTELLI feature layer contains twelve subdivision polygons and cannot be relabelled as ten CAP areas.
postal_system.service_status_rule: Office presence, opening, contact, and embedded map location are time-stamped service assertions separate from assignment, area, and deliverability.

integration.coordinate_flow: coordinate -> rights-cleared CAP area or explicit non-area -> address graph -> explicit building relation -> AGID cell
integration.postcode_flow: canonical five-digit CAP -> operator assignment evidence -> valid official/derived/virtual area or explicit non-area -> address context -> explicit building relation -> AGID cells
integration.building_output_gate: explicit distributable relation, common authoritative identifier, or reviewed crosswalk required

quality_gates.pass: CAP is stored as five-character text matching ^4789\d$ without losing leading zeroes.
A current complete assignment and exception denominator is fixed with version, date, bytes, SHA-256, correction policy, and compatible rights.
47891 Dogana and 47899 Serravalle are reconciled using source-defined membership and geometry rather than an inferred administrative split.
Every drawable CAP uses finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry in the declared CRS with class, lineage, date, confidence, and exceptions.
Every assignment and geometry resource pins exact processing, storage, derivation, redistribution, public-serving, and attribution permission.
Synthetic fixtures and shared code capability never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current complete Poste San Marino five-digit CAP assignment and exception denominator is pinned under explicit reviewed AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public-serving permission. Every drawable code is reconciled to a valid fixed Polygon/MultiPolygon whose official/derived/virtual status, provider, edition, reference date, rights, attribution, bytes, SHA-256, schema, CRS, topology, coverage, method, confidence and exceptions are recorded; non-area codes retain an explicit source-grounded reason. The nine Castelli and twelve CASTELLI sub-polygons remain administrative context and never substitute for CAP areas; in particular, 47891 Dogana and 47899 Serravalle require a source-defined postal split. The approved immutable artifact drives the real SM API/app, which normalizes five text digits, handles loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and displays selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.
Explicit address identifiers and points pass rights, schema, coverage, validity, privacy, and correction gates.
CAP surfaces and building joins pass topology, ambiguity, identifier, rights, and quality gates.
